page_title: SHU 1-3 BOU | Sheffield Utd v Bournemouth 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Andy Madley has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+7' 1 - 3 Goal – 1:3! George Baldock sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the bottom right corner.
90+4' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+3' A cross into the box from Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is cleared.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Sheffield Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
87' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range.
87' Bournemouth force a corner. They send men into the box.
83' None of the Sheffield Utd players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
83' The attendance for today's match is 30208.
82' Substitution. Marcus Tavernier is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
81' Here is a change. Gustavo Hamer is going off and Paul Heckingbottom gives the last tactical orders to John Fleck (Sheffield Utd).
81' James McAtee goes off the pitch and William Osula (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
80' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' 44:56 – the ratio of ball possession.
76' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' Relief for Philip Billing (Bournemouth) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.

71' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Philip Billing (Bournemouth), but referee Andy Madley must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
70' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd).
70' Yellow card! It's like Philip Billing (Bournemouth) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Andy Madley agrees and books him.
69' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
66' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Justin Kluivert and he is replaced by Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
66' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) replaces Antoine Semenyo.
66' It's time for a substitution. Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) comes on in place of Luke Thomas.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.
64' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
62' Bournemouth are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
57' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

54' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Wesley Foderingham, who tips the ball around the post.
53' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
51' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.

51' 0 - 3 Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) meets a perfect cross from Adam Smith deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner via the post. It's 0:3.
50' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
48' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) comes off for Oliver McBurnie.
46' Andoni Iraola makes a half-time substitution. Milos Kerkez comes on in place of Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth).
46' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.
46' Paul Heckingbottom makes a switch. Anel Ahmedhodzic is coming on in place of Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Andy Madley blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' A short pass from Antoine Semenyo puts Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails high over the bar.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
41' Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul after Adam Smith (Bournemouth) hacks down one of his opponents.
40' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:4.
36' Some neat passing and movement from Sheffield Utd as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
30' The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
29' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Lloyd Kelly, but the ball goes a whisker wide of the left post.
22' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
22' A rebound falls to Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post.
19' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

15' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Wesley Foderingham, who tips the ball around the post.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! Antoine Semenyo plays a simple square pass into the feet of Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
11' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
8' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' One of the players from Bournemouth times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
4' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Sheffield Utd will take the kick-off.
Andy Madley is introduced as the referee for today's match.
